name: Shore Wash
description: A thin sheet of water runs up over the first clip like the last of a wave on a beach, its lobed front edged with bubbly foam; it slows, stops just past the far edge and drains back, leaving the second clip wet and glossy as it dries. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the water runs up toward (x right, y up)

params.name: foam
params.description: Amount of foam on the front and left behind

params.name: refraction
params.description: How much the sheet of water bends the picture under it
